name: Kim'jael's "Missing" Equipment
summary: Kim'jael asks you to retrieve a rune held by naga in the Ruins of Eldarath. Bring it back to him in Azshara.

sections.title: A Rune in Eldarath
sections.body: The naga hold a rune in the Ruins of Eldarath. Kim'jael asks you to find it and bring it back to him in Azshara.

faq.answer: Kim'jael asks you to find a rune held by naga in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to him in Azshara.
The naga have the rune in the Ruins of Eldarath.
Naga in the Ruins of Eldarath have the rune Kim'jael seeks.
Kim'jael is in Azshara, where he asks you to return the rune.
